about: What docs/javascripts/projects.js reads of the data of the dashboard of the blueprint at /repo-blueprint/dashboard/: the schema of repos.json that it knows, the kind of every field that it reads of an entry of repos.json, of its health and of a day of history.json, and in feed the kind of every field of repos.json itself that the script does without and the watch alone reads, such as generated, the time at which the dashboard wrote it, which the watch wants no older than a day. The watch of the catalog bot, python3 -I .github/mkdocs_project.py --watch, checks the live data against it every day, whose KINDS describe each kind, and tests/projects.test.mjs checks that the script knows this schema and reads these fields and no other: change both with the script.
